name: ScratchMate
desc: A programmable, ephemeral scratchpad for macOS
typing: A programmable, ephemeral scratchpad for macOS
Global hotkey, throwaway buffers, :: text commands
Live format preview, everything local in SQLite
Liquid Glass, native Swift, no account

hero.alt: ScratchMate editor with the command reference and footer

tagline: The mental lightness of Antinote with the workbench soul of TextMate: throwaway notes, navigable by swipe, with :: commands and live format preview.
pitch: **ScratchMate** opens instantly from a global hotkey and hands you a buffer that understands code. Write, transform with `::` commands, swipe to the next note, throw it away. Nothing you type leaves your Mac.

what.product: ephemeral scratchpad for developers, native to macOS
what.platform: macOS 14+, Swift + AppKit, Liquid Glass on macOS 26
what.open: global hotkey, menu bar app, no Dock icon
what.commands: :: text commands (format, transform, preview) inside the buffer
what.storage: local SQLite only, no account, no cloud, no sync
what.install: Homebrew cask or signed DMG from Releases
